label: Triangle sides
prompt_template: How many sides does a triangle have?
explanation_template: A triangle has 3 sides and 3 vertices.

label: Rectangle vertices
prompt_template: How many vertices does a rectangle have?
explanation_template: A rectangle has 4 corners, also called vertices.

label: Cube faces
prompt_template: How many flat faces does a cube have?
explanation_template: A cube has 6 square flat faces.

label: Cylinder flat faces
prompt_template: How many flat circular faces does a cylinder have?
explanation_template: A cylinder has 2 flat circular faces and one curved surface.

label: Squares compose rectangle
prompt_template: How many same-size squares side by side can compose a rectangle?
explanation_template: Two same-size squares can join edge-to-edge to make a rectangle.

label: Triangles compose hexagon
prompt_template: How many same-size triangles can meet at the center to compose a hexagon?
explanation_template: Six same-size triangles can compose a hexagon without gaps or overlaps.

label: Halves parts
prompt_template: How many equal parts make halves?
explanation_template: Halves split one whole into 2 equal parts.

label: Fourths parts
prompt_template: How many equal parts make fourths?
explanation_template: Fourths split one whole into 4 equal parts.

label: Category count
prompt_template: A chart shows apples: 3, bananas: 5, oranges: 2. How many apples are shown?
explanation_template: Read the count next to the apples category.

label: Sorted total
prompt_template: A chart shows red: 4 and blue: 6. How many items are sorted in all?
explanation_template: Add the category counts to get the total number of sorted items.

label: Tallest bar count
prompt_template: A bar graph shows cats: 4, dogs: 7, fish: 3. How many votes did dogs get?
explanation_template: Read the count from the dogs bar.

label: Picture graph count
prompt_template: A picture graph has 5 soccer balls. Each picture means 1 vote. How many votes is that?
explanation_template: Each picture stands for one vote, so count the pictures.

label: Dot count
prompt_template: A dot plot has 4 dots above 6. How many data values are 6?
explanation_template: Each dot is one data value above that label.

label: Two labels dot count
prompt_template: A dot plot has 3 dots above 2 and 5 dots above 3. How many dots are there in all?
explanation_template: Add the dots above both labels to count all data values.

label: Frequency lookup
prompt_template: A frequency table shows apples: 4, bananas: 6, oranges: 3. What is the frequency for bananas?
explanation_template: Read the count listed beside bananas.

label: Frequency total
prompt_template: A frequency table shows red: 5, blue: 4, green: 7. How many items are in the data set?
explanation_template: Add all frequencies to get the data set size.

label: Largest value
prompt_template: In a stem-and-leaf plot, stem 4 has leaves 1, 5, 8. What is the greatest value?
explanation_template: Join the stem with the largest leaf to read 48.

label: Value count
prompt_template: In a stem-and-leaf plot, stem 3 has leaves 0, 2, 2, 7. How many values are listed?
explanation_template: Each leaf represents one data value.

label: Paired rule
prompt_template: Paired data follows y = 3x. What y-value pairs with x = 5?
explanation_template: Use the rule to find the matching y-value.

label: Ordered pair x
prompt_template: A scatterplot point is (6, 18). What is its x-value?
explanation_template: The x-value is the first coordinate in the ordered pair.

label: How many more
prompt_template: A graph shows apples: 7 and oranges: 3. How many more apples than oranges are there?
explanation_template: Subtract the smaller count from the larger count.

label: Graph total
prompt_template: A graph shows 4 sunny days and 2 rainy days. How many days are shown in all?
explanation_template: Add the two displayed counts to answer a total question.
